info.title: Event Tracker
info.description: This is the API documentation for the Event Tracker App project.

get.description: Returns an Event relating to a valid id. Otherwise returns an error.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the event to retrieve

get.description: Returns a list of Events relating to a valid user. Otherwise returns an error.
Returns a list of Events relating to a search term.
Returns a list of Events relating to a specific date.
Returns a list of Events happening between the start and end date.
Returns a list of Events relating to the specified filter options.

post.description: Adds the user-proposed changes to the database and returns the saved feedback.

get.description: Returns a list of Events created by the authenticated user.

post.description: Create Events from the provided event objects.

put.description: Update an existing event given a valid id.

delete.description: Delete events specified in the list of event ids.

post.description: Create user accounts from the given list of usernames.

get.description: Returns a list of accounts created by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete accounts specified in the list of account ids.

get.description: Returns the preferences for the authenticated user.
Returns a list of Logs after the specified timestamp..

post.description: Adds new logs to the database.

get.description: Returns a list of Execution created by the authenticated user

post.description: Create a new execution and return the execution object.

get.description: Returns a list of all keywords.

put.description: Updates the list of keywords for a given field.

get.description: Returns if the authenticated user has unviewed errors or not.

put.description: Updates the last seen error id.

post.description: Authenticate an existing user. Returns a jwtToken if the user is valid, otherwise returns an error.
Create a new user. Returns a jwtToken if the details are unique, otherwise returns an error.
